description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_Node_Element, representing an element node within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties for tag name, attributes, children, and methods for token conversion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node_Element
classes.description: Represents an HTML element node with properties for tag name, attributes, children, and methods for token conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an element node with tag name, attributes, position, and armor.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: Converts the element node to a pair of tokens representing start and end tags, or a single empty token if self-closing.
